components.description: Real, reusable local Figma component (not an ad-hoc reconstruction) for every collapsible section in the View Order drawer body: Variant=Pickup From / Pickup From + Proof of Pickup / Deliver To / Proof of Delivery / Items / Payment Info / More Info (Pre-Dispatch / Post Assignment / Post Completion) × Size=Open/Closed × State=Idle/Hover. Structure: a Content Primitives (Section Heading) header — title + chevron toggle in Trailing Content's Interactive Elements slot — over a List Group of Content Primitives (Vertical List Row) fields, in a bordered/rounded card (fill --surface-neutral-bg-default, border --border-neutral-default, radius --rounding-xl/12, pad 20, header→body gap 12, field-row gap 20). Implemented in code as the local `Section`/`Field`/`FieldRows` helpers in apps/playground/src/components/orderDetail/OrderDetailDrawer.tsx — verified structurally matching this component (padding/radius/gaps/tokens all line up); kept as local composition rather than promoted to @leta/components because it is Playground-specific drawer chrome, not a general-purpose DS molecule.

components.name: Order Overview Card
sourceFiles: LETA Playground — Order Management / Order Management Components (852:159917)
components.structure: 13 variants (one per status incl. Scheduled 1/2 + Pending 1/2), all 736x168, HORIZONTAL align CENTER. LEFT = Order Mini Map View 368x168 with its own 1px --border-neutral-default border (the two halves' borders meet as the card's vertical divider): route vectors (planned #192037 dashed w3 / driven #ff3941 solid w3), depot pin (ellipse #ff3941 + Icon/Depot), drop-off pin (ellipse #192037 + Location normally, #cd3234 + Icon/Cancel-Circle when failed, #50a20f + Icon/Check-Circle when delivered), and a 32x32 Secondary Icon-Only Expand button top-right. RIGHT = Order Status Summary 368x168, VERTICAL gap 20, pad [16,20,16,20], justify CENTER, 1px border: (a) Metrics Section (H gap 20) > SLA Visibility (V gap 8) = Content>Eyebrow (H gap 4: Label/M/Regular --text-default-eyebrow-text + Icon/Question-Outline 16) over Metric (H gap 8, SPACE_BETWEEN, align CENTER, h24) holding the counter TEXT and — CRITICALLY — the SLA Desktop Badges instance, which sits on the METRIC row centred against the counter, NOT beside the eyebrow; (b) a 328x1px Demarcator; (c) a Content Primitives (Utility) row = Title/Subtext (gap 4) + Trailing Content (gap 16, MAX) > Interactive Elements SLOT > CTA Desktop Button 110x40. Every SLA badge carries a filled leading icon: On-Time=Check-Circle (#e7f2de), At Risk=Warning (#fff8eb), Delayed=Error (#fbefef), Returned='Prev: {duration}'=History (#f5f5f5). Scheduled 1 and Scheduled 2 hide the badge instance entirely.
components.description: Real, reusable local Figma component — the summary card at the top of the View Order drawer body (736×168, HORIZONTAL, 50/50). Left half = Order Mini Map View (368×168, a map render + route vectors + Map Icon pins + a Secondary/Small Icon-Only Expand button top-right). Right half = Order Status Summary (368×168, pad [16,20,16,20], gap 20, justify center): a Metrics Section holding the SLA Visibility block (eyebrow + ⓘ + elapsed counter + ' / 30m SLA' + trailing SLA badge), a horizontal Demarcator, and a Content Primitives (Utility) row (summary main/sub copy + a Secondary CTA). One variant per lifecycle state (e.g. 'Assigned Order Overview'). Implemented in OrderDetailDrawer.tsx (hand-composed summary card, map via OrderDetailMap/MapView) — padding/gaps verified matching (16/20, gap 20, 50/50 split). The 'SLA Visibility' entry below is the nested sub-region of this card.

components.name: Map Legend
sourceFiles: LETA Playground — Order Management / Expanded Map Modals (1522:115768)
components.description: Real, reusable local Figma component — the route key pill pinned bottom-centre of the expanded order map. Property 1=1 Route / 2 Routes. Pill: --surface-neutral-bg-default, 1px --border-neutral-default, --rounding-round, height 40, pad [10,16], gap 16. Each item = a 32px sample line + Label/S/Medium caption: 'Planned Route' (dark #192037, dashed 3/3) and 'Driven Route' (red #ff3941, solid), split by a 20px vertical demarcator. Shown only when a route is drawn — hidden pre-dispatch and for cancelled-before-dispatch. Implemented as the local MapLegend in apps/playground/src/components/orderDetail/OrderDetailMap.tsx.

components.name: Map Card
sourceFiles: LETA Playground — Order Management / Order Management Components / Miscellaneous order view components (1454:207950)
components.description: Real, reusable local Figma component (not an ad-hoc reconstruction) — supersedes the prior 'Expanded-map info card' ad-hoc entry (stale nodeId 1419:462091, from the original Overview wireframe before the designer componentized it). Property 1=Pickup / Property 1=Drop-off variants: white floating card affixed to a map pin — leading icon tile + name + truncated address. Exact geometry (re-read 2026-07-27): 250×56, VERTICAL, pad 8, --rounding-xl (12), fill --surface-neutral-bg-default, 1px --border-neutral-default, 3-layer drop shadow (--shadow-neutral-2); Content HORIZONTAL gap 8 = a 40×40 --surface-neutral-bg-tertiary tile at --rounding-lg holding a 20px outlined icon, then a VERTICAL gap-4 stack of Label/S/SemiBold title (--text-default-heading) + Label/S/Regular address (--text-default-sub-body), both ellipsis-truncated. Rendered in OrderDetailMap.tsx as a Leaflet divIcon anchored centred ~18px above its pin.
